fields.text:
First-click is a $0 dare from a Ximending night desk: the still-warm slip + the selected path POST to a public HTTPS echo (https://httpbingo.org/post, json mode). The picker rides in the body — it does not retarget the fetch. URL and mode stay on the echo so Run works with no local server, no NanoGPT spend, no upload. The echo hands back the posted line — if you see the receipt, the wire works.

NanoGPT chat contract instead: pick the localhost line, then set the endpoint mode to chat and URL to http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/chat/completions, and start the 20-line mock in the Custom endpoint guide. Chrome may ask once for local-network access.

Ximending night desk, 2:17am — Wuchang Street neon on the laminate, still-warm thermal slip: one late check-in, one borrowed umbrella, NT$100 key deposit. The graph is the product. This line is just the receipt — echo me so I know the POST wasn't a rumor.
